title: Coordinate LeftBlock hook adoption receipt
description: Hook installation/testing is owned by the separate LeftBlock rollout task. Preserve existing BotSpy receipt hook and policy; record installation and synthetic verification without duplicating implementation.

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: LeftBlock owner installed and verified pre-commit protection in the common Git store, covering the main checkout and both release worktrees. Existing receipt hook, policy, secret, HEAD, index and tracked content preserved. Exact installed hook accepted a clean synthetic commit and blocked a sensitive synthetic commit with disposable HEAD unchanged. Hook SHA-256: 5bdabcce20796434d6bf4f65570cc34287365c8269f2c72439c955704cec0ed9. No hook implementation duplicated by release task; local installation receipt retained with release evidence.
